items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 25 at 5:15PM EDT until September 27 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Warning, two to three feet of
inundation above ground level in low-lying areas near shorelines
and tidal waterways. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking
waves of 8 to 12 feet in the surf zone. For the Beach Hazards
Statement, a high risk of rip currents.

* WHERE...In Maryland, the Maryland Beaches. In Virginia,
Accomack and Northampton Counties.

* WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, through Sunday
evening. For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 3 AM EDT Sunday.
For the High Surf Advisory, until 7 AM EDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Widespread flooding of vulnerable areas will result
in an elevated threat of property damage to homes and businesses
near the waterfront and shoreline. Water will be 2 to 3 feet
above ground level in some areas resulting in a sufficient depth
to close numerous roads and threaten homes and businesses.
Flooding will extend inland from the waterfront along tidal
rivers and bays resulting in some road closures and flooding of
vehicles.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued September 25 at 7:47AM EDT until September 26 at 11:00AM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 45 to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...In Maryland, Inland Worcester and Maryland Beaches
Counties. In Virginia, Northampton and Accomack Counties.

* WHEN...From 5 PM this afternoon to 11 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Storm Warning issued September 25 at 2:34PM EDT until September 26 at 7:00AM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 30 to 40 kt with gusts up to 50 kt and seas
11 to 16 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Fenwick Island DE to Chincoteague
VA out 20 NM and Coastal waters from Chincoteague to Parramore
Island VA out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Storm force winds and hazardous seas will capsize or
damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should remain in port, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for severe conditions.
